verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided in-game Adele text dated 2026-08-08. Recommendation tags are derived from the source-backed kit.

abilities.name: Crown of Thorns
abilities.description: Damaging Enemy Heroes applies Thorns to the target for 4s. Additional applications refresh the duration. Cannot be applied to Epic Monsters. Allies deal 6% of their damage as bonus true damage to Enemies afflicted by Thorns.

abilities.name: Royal Flourish
abilities.description: Adele swings her sword, gaining 40% Movement Speed for the duration. She deals 5.0/15.0/25.0/35.0/45.0 (+50.0/60.0/70.0/80.0/90.0% physical power) physical damage twice to nearby Enemies and Mesmerizes them for 1s. Mesmerized Enemies are immune to Slows. Adele then slams her sword down in an area to deal 70.0/90.0/110.0/130.0/150.0 (+7% max health) true damage to all Enemies hit.

abilities.name: Iron Rose
abilities.description: Adele equips her shield for 4.5s, increasing her hitbox size and gaining 20.0/22.5/25.0/27.5/30.0% (+4% physical armor)(+4% magical armor) Damage Reduction. This can be cast during other abilities. On cast, she attaches a Thorned Vine to Enemy Heroes and Monsters within 800u. The Vine deals 6.0/8.0/10.0/12.0/14.0 (+0.7% max health) true damage every 0.5s for the duration. The Vine snaps if an Enemy moves more than 1000u away.

abilities.name: Imperial Lash
abilities.description: Adele unfurls her Sword in a straight line, dealing 45.0/65.0/85.0/105.0/125.0 (+50% physical damage) true damage to all Enemies it passes through. If she hits an Enemy Hero or Monster, they are Rooted for 0.6s and Adele dashes to the furthest target hit.

abilities.name: Queen's Garden
abilities.description: Adele performs a small leap, slamming her shield into the ground, summoning a large Thornbush at her location for 8s. Vines attach to all Enemies within the central section, dealing 55.0/90.0/125.0 (+5% max health) physical damage. This Interrupts abilities, Roots Enemies for 0.75s, and pulls flying Enemies to the ground. All Enemies inside the Thornbush are Slowed by 35.0/37.5/40.0% and take 4.0/7.0/10.0 true damage every 35u moved within it.

augments.name: Tyrant of Thorns
augments.description: Adele triggers Crown of Thorns at 300% effectiveness. Royal Flourish has 9.0/8.5/8.0/7.5/7.0 Cooldown and provides 50% Movement Speed, but no longer Mesmerizes.

augments.name: Court of Roses
augments.description: Iron Rose grants nearest Ally a 5s barrier with 20% Damage Reduction and attaches Thorned Vines to nearby Enemy Heroes dealing 50% damage.

augments.name: Seeds of Dominion
augments.description: Imperial Lash spawns a Thornbush under the dash target, reducing its Cooldown by 10%. Enemies are Slowed 10% and take 2.0/2.5/3.0/3.5/4.0 True Damage per 35u moved inside the Thornbush.

verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided in-game Akeron text dated 2026-08-08. Recommendation tags are derived from the source-backed kit.

abilities.name: Pact of the Devourer
abilities.description: Akeron gains up to 100 stacks of Hunger, each granting 0.25% increased healing and lasting 3s and refreshing on application. Akeron gains Hunger each time he hits an Enemy Unit with a basic attack or ability. He gains additional Hunger when damaged by an Enemy Hero. When Akeron reaches max stacks he becomes Awakened for 10s granting him 5.0/5.8/6.5/7.3/8.0/8.8/9.5/10.3/11.0/11.8/12.5/13.3/14.0/14.8/15.5/16.3/17.0/17.8% (+0.75% per level) Damage Reduction, and granting his basic abilities extra effects.

abilities.name: Hellfire
abilities.description: Akeron opens his maw and launches the Demon's Eye forward. The Eye moves slowly, firing off 10 (+10% haste) fireballs around it. Refire the ability to pause the Eye mid-flight. Each fireball deals 18.0/29.0/40.0/51.0/62.0 (+18% magical power) magical damage and Slows Enemies by 7%, up to a max of 35%. If an Enemy is within range, the Eye will fire an additional homing fireball at them. Each subsequent hit on the same Target deals 20% less damage, stacking up to a 80% reduction. When Awakened, the number of fireballs is increased by 50%.

abilities.name: Web Lash
abilities.description: Akeron fires a web, stopping on the first Target hit and causing various effects depending on the Target type. Heroes or Units: Damages for 70.0/95.0/120.0/145.0/170.0 (+40% magical power) magical damage and Roots for 1s, also creating a web field that Slows Enemies by 35%. World: Lashes to it for up to 5s. While attached to terrain, Akeron can use abilities or leap to the ground, dealing 60.0/85.0/110.0/135.0/160.0 (+50% physical power)(+40% magical power) physical damage, Knocking Up, and Stunning Enemies for 1s. Awakened: Root and Stun Duration increased to 1.25.

abilities.name: Crushing Maw
abilities.description: Akeron deals 70.0/90.0/110.0/130.0/150.0 (+65% physical power)(+40% magical power)(+4% max health) physical damage in a cone. Enemies close to Akeron take 1.35x damage. Akeron also heals for 8.0/12.0/16.0/20.0/24.0 (+1.8/2.5/3.3/4.0/4.8% max health). The heal is reduced to 20% for Non-Heroes, and increased by 200% on kill. If an Enemy Hero is killed, Akeron becomes Awakened. While Akeron is attached to terrain, this ability becomes a roar, affecting the area around him. Awakened: Shred 15.0/17.5/20.0/22.5/25.0% Physical Armor and Magical Armor for 5s.

abilities.name: Consume
abilities.description: Akeron Slows himself by 35% while Pulling and dealing 15.0/20.0/25.0 (+5% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in a cone every 0.25s for 3s. If an Enemy Hero collides with Akeron, he bites them, dealing 55.0/75.0/95.0 (+75% physical power)(+45% magical power) physical damage while healing for 2.5/3.5/4.5% Missing Health + 40.0/50.0/60.0% of bite damage dealt. Akeron Executes Enemies bitten under 12% (+3.5% physical power)(+2.5% magical power) of their Max Health. Each time Akeron successfully executes a Hero, he gains 100.0/125.0/150.0 Maximum Health permanently, also healing for 2.5x the bite value.

augments.name: Trapdoor Demon
augments.description: Akeron becomes camouflaged when attaching to terrain, gaining 1.5% Max Health Regen and generating 8 Hunger per second while he remains there.

augments.name: Death From Above
augments.description: Akeron can fire an additional web projectile from the wall or ground once, allowing him to leap from surface to surface or to Root from where he hangs.

augments.name: Roar of Torment
augments.description: Consume now Pushes instead of Pulls and deals 275% increased tick damage, but can no longer bite.

abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3% magical power) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 85.0/125.0/165.0/205.0/245.0 (+50% magical power) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1.0/1.1/1.1/1.1/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 20.0/30.0/40.0/50.0/60.0 (+18% magical power) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25.0/30.0/35.0/40.0/45.0% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13.0/20.0/27.0/34.0/41.0 (+18% magical power) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3.0/4.0/5.0 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 130.0/155.0/180.0 (+25% magical power) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 50% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

verification.notes: Revised from user-provided in-game Argus text dated 2026-08-08. Recommendation tags are derived from the source-backed kit.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing 62.0/65.0/68.2/71.5/75.0/78.7/82.5/86.5/90.6/94.9/99.4/104.0/108.8/113.7/118.8/124.1/129.5/135.1 (+75% physical power) physical damage. Additionally deals (+30% magical power) magical damage on-hit.

abilities.name: Frozen Simulacrum
abilities.description: Aurora can jump whilst airborne to leap in the direction she is moving, leaving behind a Replica of herself. This cooldown is reduced by 4s when Immobilizing Heroes. The Replica has (+20% max health)(+150% magical power) Health, will draw aggro from Enemy Towers, and lasts for 8s. Damaging an Enemy Hero or Monster 4 times will summon a Frost Storm around Aurora for 3s, refreshing on additional damage dealt. The Storm deals 5 (+30% magical power) +1.0/1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2.0/2.2/2.4/2.6/2.8/3.0/3.2/3.4/3.6/3.8/4.0/4.2/4.4% (+0.2% per level) Enemy Max Health magical damage per second.

abilities.name: Glacial Charge
abilities.description: Aurora dashes forward, leaving behind a wall of ice that other Heroes can walk on for the next 5s. Reactivating the ability will destroy the wall early. Aurora can stop her movement mid-way by using Hoarfrost or Cryoseism, or by Jumping. Additionally, Aurora and her Allies gain 25.0/30.0/35.0/40.0/45.0% Movement Speed while walking on the ice.

abilities.name: Hoarfrost
abilities.description: Aurora creates a ring of frost on the ground around her. Enemies that touch the ring take 70.0/110.0/150.0/190.0/230.0 (+50% magical power) magical damage and are Rooted for 1.0/1.1/1.1/1.1/1.2s. The ring remains in the world for 2.5s.

abilities.name: Boreal Sweep
abilities.description: Aurora summons a wave of frost in a cone dealing 40.0/55.0/70.0/85.0/100.0 (+35% magical power) magical damage and Slowing Enemy Targets hit by 30.0/35.0/40.0/45.0/50.0% for 0.9s. After a short delay the frost erupts, dealing an additional 80.0/110.0/140.0/170.0/200.0 (+60% magical power) magical damage.

abilities.name: Cryoseism
abilities.description: Aurora freezes an area, applying a 50% Slow to all Enemies for 1.5s. After 1.5s, the ice freezes, Stunning the target for 1s. After the Stun, the Target explodes dealing 200.0/300.0/400.0 (+70% magical power) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies. Enemies damaged by Cryoseism will be Slowed by 50% for 0.5s before exploding, dealing 60.0/90.0/120.0 (+20% magical power) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies. Targets can only be slowed this way once per Cryoseism.

augments.name: Glacial Thorns
augments.description: Glacial Charge spawns Hoarfrost Crystals at its base that deal 40.0/60.0/80.0/100.0/120.0 (+20% magical power) Damage and Root for 0.5s.

augments.name: Frozen Fury
augments.description: Frost Storm grants 10-34% Attack Speed while active. Increases with Hero Level.

augments.name: Hypothermia
augments.description: Damaging Enemy Heroes with Boreal Sweep shreds 15% Physical Armor and Magical Armor and slows Attack Speed by 20% for 3s.

verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided in-game Aurora text dated 2026-08-08. Recommendation tags are derived from the source-backed kit.

abilities.name: Vigil
abilities.description: Melee basic attack chain dealing 52.0/54.8/57.8/60.9/64.1/67.5/71.0/74.8/78.6/82.6/86.8/91.0/95.5/100.1/104.8/109.8/114.8/120.0 (+65% physical power) physical damage. 1.0/1.0/2.3x Damage and Swing Time Chain.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: When Bayle drops below 40% of his Maximum Health, he enters Berserk for 7s. While Berserk, Bayle gains 15.0/19.0/23.0/27.0/31.0/35.0/39.0/43.0/47.0/51.0/55.0/59.0/63.0/67.0/71.0/75.0/79.0/83.0% (+3% per level) Attack Speed, 4.0/4.5/5.0/5.5/6.0/6.5/7.0/7.5/8.0/8.5/9.0/9.5/10.0/10.5/11.0/11.5/12.0/12.5% (+0.5% per level) Movement Speed, and 40 Tenacity. Bayle can only enter Berserk once every 20s.

abilities.name: Cursed Edge
abilities.description: Bayle activates the runes on his arm, swinging 3 times to conjure slashes of cursed energy that pierce through all Enemies, dealing 35.0/50.0/65.0/80.0/95.0 (+75% physical power)(+50% magical power) physical damage each. The first two slashes are vertical, while the third is horizontal and Knocks Up and Stuns all Enemies it hits for 0.65s. If Bayle hits the same Target with all 3 slashes, they take 5.0/10.0/15.0/20.0/25.0 (+18% physical power)(+15% magical power) bonus bleed damage every 0.5s for 3s.

abilities.name: Dire Howl
abilities.description: Bayle howls out a battle cry, dealing 50.0/65.0/80.0/95.0/110.0 (+30% physical power)(+65% magical power) physical damage around him and Slowing Enemies hit by 30% for 1.25s. Additionally, Bayle is buffed for 5s, gaining 8.0/12.0/16.0/20.0/24.0 (+25% magical power) bonus Physical Power and 8.0/10.0/12.0/14.0/16.0% Omnivamp. When the buff ends, Bayle Heals for 10.0/14.0/18.0/22.0/26.0% of his damage taken during the duration.

abilities.name: Skull Crusher
abilities.description: Bayle leaps a set distance forward, flipping in the air and slamming his sword into the ground to deal 90.0/130.0/170.0/210.0/250.0 (+110% physical power) physical damage in the area. Enemies hit by the slam are marked for 4s, Shredding their Physical Armor by 20.0/22.5/25.0/27.5/30.0% and granting Bayle 30% increased Movement Speed toward them. The leap can be cancelled early, allowing Bayle to slam immediately below him.

abilities.name: Kingslayer
abilities.description: Bayle Slows himself by 60% while he gathers cursed energy, then dashing forward at blinding speed. If Bayle hits an Enemy Hero, he stops dashing and swings his sword in a massive uppercut, throwing them into the air while pummeling them with a barrage of 8 sword strikes, each dealing 30.0/40.0/50.0 (+24% physical power) (+1.0/1.3/1.6% Target's Max Health) physical damage. Finally, Bayle slams the Enemy into the ground, dealing 70.0/95.0/120.0 (+75% physical power) (+3.0/4.0/5.0% Target's Max Health) physical damage in a small area around where they land.

augments.name: Frenzied Fighter
augments.description: Berserk has no cooldown and can remain on indefinitely while under the Health threshold.

augments.name: Swift Strikes
augments.description: After casting an ability, Bayle gains 45% Attack Speed for one attack. Additionally, he automatically starts with the 3rd attack in his Basic Attack chain, but it always deals 20% decreased damage.

augments.name: Betrayer's Reqiuem
augments.description: Kingslayer uppercuts all Enemies in an area around the initial Target. Additionally, Kingslayer's Cooldown is reduced by 15%.

verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided in-game Bayle text dated 2026-08-09. Recommendation tags are derived from the source-backed kit.

abilities.name: Tesseract Device
abilities.description: Every second Basic Attack On-Hit against Heroes & Monsters grants Boris a Canister for 5s, up to a maximum of 4. Each Canister grants Boris 7.0/10.0/13.0/16.0% Attack Speed and 1.0/1.3/1.5/1.8/2.0/2.3/2.5/2.8/3.0/3.3/3.5/3.8/4.0/4.3/4.5/4.8/5.0/5.3 (+2% physical power)(+0.25 per Level) Healing On-Hit. At max Canisters, Boris unleashes his Tesseract Core. The Core zaps Enemies On-Hit, dealing 5.0/7.0/9.0/11.0/13.0/15.0/17.0/19.0/21.0/23.0/25.0/27.0/29.0/31.0/33.0/35.0/37.0/39.0 (+10% physical power)(+12% magical power)(+2 per Level) magical damage and Healing Boris for 4.0/5.0/6.0/7.0/8.0/9.0/10.0/11.0/12.0/13.0/14.0/15.0/16.0/17.0/18.0/19.0/20.0/21.0 (+10% physical power)(+1 per Level), reduced to 20% effectiveness against Non-Heroes.

abilities.name: Detection Protocol
abilities.description: Boris sniffs the air, Marking a nearby Enemy Hero and generating a Scent Trail to their location for 8s. While moving along the Trail, Boris gains 45.0/55.0/65.0/75.0/85.0% (+15% magical power) Movement Speed. Dealing Hero Damage to the Marked Target consumes the Mark, ending the Trail effect, Slowing the Target by 35% for 1.25s and granting Boris 1 Canister. If no Hero is found, 40% of the Cooldown is refunded.

abilities.name: Primeval Roar
abilities.description: Boris generates a defensive Barrier, granting him 20.0/22.5/25.0/27.5/30.0% Damage Reduction for 2.5s. After the duration, Boris roars, exploding the Barrier and dealing 40.0/55.0/70.0/85.0/100.0 (+30% physical power)(+70% magical power) magical damage to all nearby Enemies. Enemies hit are Feared for 0.5-1s, based on Barrier duration. Boris may manually detonate the Barrier after 0.5s.

abilities.name: Chrono Swipe
abilities.description: Boris dashes forward, swiping all Enemies in his path twice. Each hit deals 20.0/30.0/40.0/50.0/60.0 (+44.0/48.0/52.0/56.0/60.0% physical power) physical damage and applies On-Hit effects.

abilities.name: Ursine Burst
abilities.description: Boris hovers momentarily, before Dashing forward and grabbing the first Enemy Hero he collides with. Boris then leaps into the air with the grabbed Hero and slams them to the ground. All Enemies in the landing zone take 250.0/350.0/450.0 (+160% physical power) (+30.0/45.0/60.0% Target's Bonus Health) physical damage and are Slowed by 75% for 1.25s.

augments.name: Bolster Bearicade
augments.description: While Tesseract Core is active, gain 15% increased Armors.

augments.name: Savage Shred
augments.description: Detection Protocol's Mark Shreds 35% Physical Armor for 5s when consumed.

augments.name: Apex Hunter
augments.description: Chrono Swipe deals 70% more damage to Heroes below 20% Max Health.

verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided in-game Boris text dated 2026-08-09. Recommendation tags are derived from the source-backed kit.

abilities.name: Blood Tithe
abilities.description: Dealing damage to an Enemy Hero with abilities two times within 4s applies Haemorrhage, dealing 4% of their maximum health as true damage over 4s, granting Countess 5% movement speed for the same duration. This effect can stack but will not refresh.

abilities.name: Shadow Slip
abilities.description: Rapidly dash to a location in a cloud of blood, dealing 40.0/60.0/80.0/100.0/120.0 (+35% magical power) magical damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 25% for 1.25s. A Shadow is left in your original position. Re-triggering the ability within 3.5s will swap places with the Shadow.

abilities.name: Eventide
abilities.description: Send out a cloud of darkness dealing 105.0/145.0/185.0/225.0/265.0 (+80% magical power) magical damage to Enemy Targets within its path.

abilities.name: Blade Siphon
abilities.description: Countess spins and strikes all Enemy Targets around her, dealing 80.0/110.0/140.0/170.0/200.0 (+60% magical power) magical damage to each and healing herself for 4.0/6.0/8.0/10.0/12.0 (+10% magical power) per Target hit. Against Heroes the healing is increased by 450%. Monsters receive 95 more damage.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.description: Leap to an Enemy Hero, forcing them to face Countess and Suppress them for 0.75s. After the duration, Countess deals 135.0/185.0/235.0 (+5% (+2.5% magical power) of the target's maximum health) magical damage and applying Haemorrhage. Targets already affected by Haemorrhage take 50% bonus damage and Countess restores health equal to 100% of the damage dealt.

augments.name: Shadow Echo

Missiles utilize laser guidance to home towards Howitzers painted target.

augments.name: Blast Off!
augments.description: Land Mine's cooldown is 15% lower and blasts Targets 30% further.

augments.name: Combat Thrusters
augments.description: Gain 30%/60%/115% Movement Speed during Make It Rain.

augments.name: Sniper Shells
augments.description: Howitzer's Basic Attacks grant him 4% Total Attack Speed and 1.5% Omnivamp for 4.5s, stacking up to 5 times.

verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided in-game Howitzer text dated 2026-08-15. Recommendation tags are derived from the source-backed kit.

abilities.name: Badlands Critter
abilities.description: Scorch hurls up oil with his basic attack that applies Slick to enemies hit, slowing them by 2.5% per stack for 3s, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Enemies with any Slick that are damaged by Flame Turrets, Molotov or Inferno are Ignited for 3s taking 3.0/3.4/3.8/4.2/4.6/5.0/5.4/5.8/6.2/6.6/7.0/7.4/7.8/8.2/8.6/9.0/9.4/9.8 (+0.4 per level) (+3% magical power) magical damage per second per stack.

abilities.name: Flame Turret
abilities.description: Iggy throws down a turret with 100 (+24 per Hero Level) (+10-32.5% magical power) Health that shoots homing fireballs at Enemy Targets within 1500 units. Each fireball deals 11.0/16.0/21.0/26.0/31.0 (+30% magical power) magical damage. Iggy can have up to 3 turrets placed. Hitting an enemy with Spew redirects turrets to attack that target if in range. They also gain 40% Attack Speed if the Target is an Enemy Hero, or when Iggy casts Inferno. Flame Turrets take 70% increased damage from Melee basic attacks.

abilities.name: Oil Spill
abilities.description: Scorch hurls a ball of oil that rolls in the target direction dealing 70.0/105.0/140.0/175.0/210.0 (+50% magical power) magical damage to enemies hit. The oil will then remain for 5s, slowing enemies by 30.0/35.0/40.0/45.0/50.0%. When ignited by Iggy's fire abilities, the duration is refreshed and enemies take 10.0/15.0/20.0/25.0/30.0 (+12% magical power) magical damage every 0.5s.

abilities.name: Molotov
abilities.description: Iggy flings a Molotov that deals 50.0/70.0/90.0/110.0/130.0 (+40% magical power) magical damage to enemies hit by the explosion. A Fire Field will remain where the explosion occurs, dealing 60.0/95.0/130.0/165.0/200.0 (+60% magical power) magical damage over 2.5s.

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.description: Scorch unleashes a cone of flame gaining 20.0/25.0/30.0% Movement Speed and dealing 375.0/600.0/825.0 (+260% magical power) magical damage over 3s. At the end of the duration, or upon reactivation, Scorch will belch, instantly dealing 120.0/180.0/240.0 (+60% magical power) magical damage in the area and Knocking Back any Enemy Heroes present.

augments.name: Turret Maniac
augments.description: Increase your Maximum Number of Turrets to 4, but they have 20% less Health.

augments.name: Badlands Belch
augments.description: Belch deals an additional (+7.0/8.5/10.0% Target's Missing Health) damage and Knocks Back 30% further.

augments.name: Hold This!
augments.description: Molotov permanently gains +5 Explosion Damage against Heroes each time its Explosion hits one.

verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided in-game Iggy & Scorch text dated 2026-08-15. Recommendation tags are derived from the source-backed kit.

abilities.name: Herald
abilities.description: Based on the chosen Eternal Category, empower Ikras abilities. Harbingers: Ikra's Fathom deals +(8% magical power) as magical damage. Hitting an Enemy with Fathom reduces the cooldown of Brine by 0.5s. Primarchs: Popping Hydroclasm now displaces Ikra. Gain 1% Movement Speed per 75 magical power. Dreadnoughts: Narcosis' Suspension duration is increased by 25% and restores 100% Health of the Hero Damage dealt by it. Sovereigns: Hydroclasm has 25% reduced Cooldown and Genesis is 25% larger. Divines: Hydroclasm's Bubbles project an aura that heals Ikra and Allied Heroes for 4.0/6.0/8.0/10.0/12.0/6.0/8.0/10.0/12.0 (+10% magical power) Health every second. Anomalies: Brine and Hydroclasm deal 3% of the Target's Maximum Health over 4s and apply 45% Anti Heal for the same duration.

abilities.name: Narcosis
abilities.description: Ikra unleashes a Water Sphere dealing 85.0/115.0/145.0/175.0/205.0 (+50% magical power) magical damage. The Sphere pierces through Enemy Units but stops on hitting an Enemy Hero, surrounding and Suspending them for 1.1s.

abilities.name: Hydroclasm
abilities.description: Ikra creates an Abyssal Bubble that Slows Enemies by 15% while they are in its radius. The Bubble can be popped by hitting it with either Fathom or Brine, dealing 25.0/35.0/45.0/55.0/65.0 (+10% magical power) magical damage to all Targets in a 520 Unit radius and restoring 30 Mana. The Bubble amplifies after 1.1s, increasing the damage dealt to 60.0/110.0/160.0/210.0/260.0 (+70% magical power) magical damage whilst Slowing all Targets hit by 40.0/45.0/50.0/55.0/60.0% for 1s. Popping a Bubble with Brine deals Brine's Damage as well as Hydroclasm's Damage. If the Bubble is amplified when popped by Brine, the total damage penetrates 40% of the Target's Magical Armor. Max Charges: 2.

abilities.name: Brine
abilities.description: Ikra fires a quick Hydroblast dealing 80.0/115.0/150.0/185.0/220.0 (+45% magical power) magical damage to the first Enemy Target hit or popping the first Bubble it impacts. Whenever Brine kills an Enemy, Ikra gains 3.0/4.0/5.0/6.0/7.0 additional Gold. Killing Enemies by Popping Bubbles with Brine also grants this Gold.

abilities.name: Genesis
abilities.description: Ikra rises into the sky for 1s and channels the tides before unleashing a surging Waterspout from his Trident that pierces Walls. The Waterspout deals 320.0/480.0/640.0 (+85% magical power) magical damage and Knocks Up Enemies hit. When Enemy Targets land from the Knock Up, they are Slowed by 50% for 1.25s.

augments.name: The Gloom
augments.description: Bubble radius grows up to 25% larger over 3s. Additionally Ikra and Allied Heroes become camouflaged when within a Bubble's Radius.

augments.name: Undertow
augments.description: Enemy Heroes Suspended by Narcosis slowly travel towards Ikra and the cooldown is decreased by 1.5s when damaging an Enemy Hero.

augments.name: Cascade
augments.description: Fathom hits grant stacks. Upon reaching 5, your next direct Brine hit deals 10 (+20% magical power) Bonus Damage. Dealing Ability damage to Enemies grants 12% Attack Speed for 4s, once per ability, stacking up to 4 times.
